all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA Sensor contributes a specific sensor-system boundary and modality to the proposed described sensing arrangement.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Does not prove generic CSAPI System identity, ownership of deployed sensors or a mandatory domain superclass.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Source's generic System/SubSystem concept permits hierarchical systems without fixing one sensing domain root.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Generic SOSA System is not always an instantiated physical sensing apparatus.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: A SOSA Hardware Element is physical and can be a sensor constituent, with source-defined configuration bounds.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Not every physical environmental probe or other equipment is a SOSA hardware element.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: PIC, aperture, chassis/enclosure and power supply are documented SOSA hardware/infrastructure examples.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: SOSA hardware architecture is not universal sensor hardware inventory or mandatory chassis hierarchy.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA Host Platform contributes concrete physical support/mounting context for a SOSA Sensor.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Does not establish source-specific geolocation, site operator, sensor's own geometry or a software host.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA Sensor Pod is an integral packaging and mounting case where sensor and pod boundaries overlap.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Cannot always treat pod as external hosting platform or as a physically separate sensor.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA External Interface crosses sensor boundary and may connect to host/environment.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Not equivalent to a distinct externally cabled ClimaVue, SDI-12 connector, or all connected equipment.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Internal interfaces and drawn physical relationships provide relation/context evidence.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Interface presence does not entail strict part-of, one function per card or installed topology.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA Module is a separately defined functional architecture role that might be implemented on physical hardware.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: It must NOT be read as physical constituent by label or produce phantom hardware/part-of edges.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA Sensor Component and generic Element can include logical/software as well as physical realizations.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Cannot silently equate 'component' with physical module, installed probe or hardware individual.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: RTE describes execution hosting of software, not a physical vehicle/structure.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Do not use unqualified platform/host terms to infer location or physical attachment.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Interaction infrastructure carries logical information exchange between modules.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Transport/binding cannot prove a distinct network-visible node, physical cable or original measurement author.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: A procurable unit may implement multiple modules/physical infrastructure elements.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Purchase unit or product type is not identical to one module, one model designation, one installed asset or one sensor.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Source's unqualified 'Platform' can describe sensor device, physical host or computing infrastructure.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Only qualified 'SOSA Host Platform' has defensible physical host interpretation.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA function/interface decomposition is not ISA CIC visible/opaque member exposure.
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Do not import ISA network member/virtual UCI semantics into SOSA without exact SOSA source evidence.

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: System Manager is a defined management module with subfunctions that can qualify generic role/service concepts
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: SOSA managing module is not ISA Controller service role or one-to-one physical component

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA external mission task request and internal assignment resemble issued action request patterns
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Task Manager interactions are preliminary; no proven user request or physical effect and no exact CSAPI Command mapping

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA task/assignment status and health reporting potentially qualify reported outcome concepts
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Published status and return codes not independent completed command or mission success

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Native SOSA Capability depends upon as-configured health and tasks/assignments, unlike ISA CCD static declarations
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: No assertion of equal actual mode/capability list or vendor hardware execution

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Finite SOSA Mode concept speaks to known behavior in a discrete mode
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Do not equate mode to default or current source-reported mode without evidence

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA mode and status message categories can contribute source-specific mode reporting notions
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Does not establish actual contemporaneous source-reported mode in one of four cases

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Sensor lifecycle/state is explicit separately from condition and health
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Do not equate SOSA state enum to ISA operating condition property

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Health diagnostics include BIT execution/results and fault reporting
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: No exact native ISA BIT property or actual device diagnostic measurement

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA reports status/health events but ISO-coded property Status report is a distinct message form
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Syslog notification is not an ISA Status property-value message

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA manager/agent may represent/manage a different component, similar to mediated participation
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: No exact ISA CIC performer/broker/relay semantics, source exposure or virtual UCI mapping

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: In-band management interface roles are networked conditional roles
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: SOSA client/server/agent role is not a unique ISA registered network participant

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Distinct notifications about state/status/fault/mode/configuration supply management change evidence
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Not equal to ISA Administrative event codes, original Observation or all messages actually delivered

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Manager-represented lifecycle at whole sensor and module/PIC level qualifies possible state context
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: State is not source-reported operating mode or proof observed live condition

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: PIC/module Lost Communication provides bounded example of diagnostic/availability ambiguity
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Loss of management path must not be treated as physical sensor health or measured actual failure

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Task assignment statuses offer some reported processing/execution context
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Not exact ISA current command execution record or verified hardware effect

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA functional modules can process sensory data but are not necessarily the physical observer
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Functional chain, data ingestor and physical sensing actor must remain separate

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Data product formatting and storage distinguish output stream/report fields and their provenance
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: No exact CSAPI resultSchema, actual Observation or original-to-digital-copy chain

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Security operational state/integrity and alerts may relate to tamper/health concepts
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Software integrity result/security state does not prove physical tamper condition

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Calibration module describes reference test signal injection separate from recurring observation procedures
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: No actual metrological calibration performed or reusable ObservingProcedure identity

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Host platform interface/nav/time supply site/host-related operational context
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Time/nav source is not surveyed position of individual instrument or installation history

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Source describes host power flow and functional power conversion/protection distinctions relevant to original case power hold
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Module reference only: no installed battery, exact voltage, state, control or actual power telemetry

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Possible power status/reference module supports concept of component power condition
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Does not establish actual ISA Power State property equivalence or real source-state measurement

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Network monitoring and QoS roles are pertinent to connection/reporting-path distinctions
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: No real source-specific radio transmission, timing, CSAPI transfer or network health proof

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Managed capabilities and manager-reported state need separate readiness interpretation
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: A supported functionality is neither a source-attested current ready flag nor a reported actual state

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Preliminary task model contrasts request/state/status/health and actual implementation
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: No source case has authenticated issued, acknowledged, completed, physically verified command sequence

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: SOSA DIV-1 mission/management conceptual scope may help categorize output and management fields
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: SOSA DIV-1 is a model layer, not output-field specification or native CSAPI result schema

all_57_qualified_source_decisions.why: Logical quantities and physical format concepts may inform typed measured data
all_57_qualified_source_decisions.guard: Narrative alone cannot establish a native SOSA measurement type/units, actual value or cardinality
